- `POST /v1/funds/{id}`：为已登记机器的零初始余额账户入金。请求须携带 `Idempotency-Key` 头（格式同上），JSON 请求体仅含且不得重复 `amountMicros`（非布尔整数 `1..9000000000000000`）与 `reference`（`[a-z0-9-]{1,64}`）。判定顺序为头、体、幂等记录、机器：头或体非法返回 `400`/`invalid_request`；同键异 `id` 或异体返回 `409`/`conflict`（即使 `id` 未登记）；机器不存在返回 `404`/`not_found`。首次入金在同一写事务内原子分配全库共享的持久化入金序号 `depositSeq`（取全库最大序号加一，空库为 `1`，跨机器唯一），机器账户记入 `amountMicros`、外部清算账户记入等额反向分录，返回 `201`，正文键序 `depositSeq,balance`，`balance` 为入金后机器账户新余额。同键同请求并发或重启后重放首次状态码与响应字节；序号、双方分录、余额与幂等结果在同一事务原子提交，失败不留记录，跨机器并发不重号、不透支。
- `POST /v1/accounts/{id}/withdrawals`：为已登记机器账户认证出金，将可用余额转至外部清算账户且不得动用争议冻结资金。请求须携带 `Idempotency-Key` 头（格式同上）与单一 `SLA-Auth` 头（见“请求认证”，机器标识须等于路径账户），不接受任何查询参数与 `SLA-Delegation` 头；JSON 请求体仅含且不得重复 `id`（沿用现有业务标识格式 `[a-z0-9-]{1,64}`）与 `amountMicros`（非布尔整数 `1..9000000000000000`）。判定顺序为头、查询参数与体、认证结构、幂等记录、账户、身份、认证、id、余额：头、查询参数、体或认证结构非法返回 `400`/`invalid_request`；同键更换路径、正文或认证五段返回 `409`/`conflict`（同键同请求并发或重启后重放首次状态码与响应字节）；账户不存在返回 `404`/`not_found`；认证机器与路径账户不符返回 `403`/`forbidden`；认证过时、密钥/签名无效与随机数异键复用沿用“请求认证”（`401`/`stale_request`、`401`/`invalid_authentication`、`409`/`replay_detected`）；异键重复 `id` 返回 `409`/`withdrawal_exists`；可用余额（总余额扣除全部 open 争议冻结后与零的较大值，冻结口径沿单笔结算）不足返回 `409`/`insufficient_funds`。出金在单个写事务内检查余额与冻结额，金额不超过可用余额才提交；首次成功在同一写事务内原子分配全库唯一、持久递增的出金序号 `withdrawalSeq`（取全库最大序号加一，空库为 `1`，跨账户唯一），借记机器账户、贷记 `external:clearing` 等额款项并生成两条 `kind` 为 `withdrawal` 的账本分录（`referenceSeq` 为出金序号、`reference` 为请求 `id`），原子保存出金记录、认证随机数与幂等结果。首次成功返回 `201`，正文键序为 `id,withdrawalSeq,amountMicros,balance,availableBalance,createdAt`：`balance` 为出金后账面余额，`availableBalance` 为扣除全部 open 争议冻结额后的可用余额，`createdAt` 为事务 UTC 毫秒非负整数。并发出金、结算与争议冻结不得透支；同键同请求并发或重启后重放首次响应字节，异键同 `id` 仅一项成功；任何失败均不消费随机数、不写分录也不推进序号。
- `POST /v1/settlements`：将一次结算评估过账为资金结算。请求须携带 `Idempotency-Key` 头（格式同上），JSON 请求体仅含且不得重复 `slaId`（`[a-z0-9-]{1,64}`）与 `evaluationSeq`（非布尔正整数）。判定顺序为头、体、幂等记录、SLA、评估归属、重复结算、金额、余额：头或体非法返回 `400`/`invalid_request`；同键异请求返回 `409`/`conflict`；SLA 或评估不存在返回 `404`/`not_found`；SLA 非 `active` 或 `sealed`，或评估不属于该 SLA 返回 `409`/`conflict`；评估已被异键结算返回 `409`/`settlement_exists`；金额或结算后余额超过 `9000000000000000` 返回 `409`/`amount_overflow`；付款方余额不足返回 `409`/`insufficient_funds`。评估为 `fulfilled` 时按快照单价乘事件数向消费者收费、转账给生产者（`charged`）；为 `breached` 时按快照单价乘违规数由生产者赔付消费者（`compensated`）；为 `insufficient` 时创建金额为零的 `pending` 结算，不产生账本分录。首次成功在同一写事务内原子分配全库共享的持久化结算序号 `settlementSeq`（取全库最大序号加一，空库为 `1`）与事务 UTC 毫秒时间 `createdAt`，双方分录、余额、结算记录与幂等结果同事务提交，失败无任何副作用。成功返回 `201`，正文键序 `settlementSeq,evaluationSeq,result,amount,createdAt`，`result` 为 `charged`、`compensated` 或 `pending`。同键同请求并发或重启后重放首次状态码与响应字节；每个评估至多结算一次，跨 SLA 并发不重号、不透支。
- `POST /v1/settlement-batches`：在单个原子事务内将一组结算评估按顺序过账为资金结算批次，不改变 `POST /v1/settlements`。请求须携带恰好一个 `Idempotency-Key` 头（格式同上；缺失、重复或格式非法返回 `400`/`invalid_request`，且不查询任何资源），JSON 请求体仅含且不得重复 `id`（沿用现有标识格式 `[a-z0-9-]{1,64}`）与 `items`；`items` 为 1 至 100 个对象的数组（空数组、非数组或数量越界均为 `400`/`invalid_request`），每个对象仅含且不得重复 `slaId`（`[a-z0-9-]{1,64}`）与 `evaluationSeq`（非布尔正整数），数组内 `(slaId,evaluationSeq)` 对必须互不重复。系统按数组顺序对各项沿用单笔结算规则（`fulfilled` 收费、`breached` 赔付、`insufficient` 记零金额 `pending` 且不写分录），前项过账后的余额可立即供后项使用（含前项收款方成为后项付款方的情形）。判定顺序为头与体、幂等记录、批次 id，其后按输入顺序判定各项：头或体非法返回 `400`/`invalid_request`；同一 Idempotency-Key 更换批次 id 或请求（逐字节）返回 `409`/`conflict`；异键重复批次 id 返回 `409`/`batch_exists`；任一项的 SLA 或评估不存在返回 `404`/`not_found`；评估不属于该 SLA 或 SLA 非 `active` 或 `sealed` 返回 `409`/`conflict`；评估已被单笔结算或其他批次结算返回 `409`/`settlement_exists`；金额或结算后余额超过 `9000000000000000` 返回 `409`/`amount_overflow`；付款方可用余额（总余额扣除全部 open 争议冻结后与零的较大值，冻结口径沿单笔结算）不足返回 `409`/`insufficient_funds`。任一项失败时整批不写批次、结算、分录或余额，也不消耗结算序号，不留幂等记录（补足条件后同键可重试）。首次成功返回 `201`，正文键序为 `id,createdAt,settlements`：`createdAt` 为全批统一的事务 UTC 毫秒非负整数；`settlements` 为与输入同序的数组，元素沿用单笔结算成功响应键序 `settlementSeq,evaluationSeq,result,amount,createdAt`，每项获得全库唯一的 `settlementSeq`（与单笔结算共享同一全库序号空间，批内按顺序连续分配），`createdAt` 均等于批次 `createdAt`。批次记录、全部结算、双方分录、余额变动与幂等结果在同一写事务原子提交；同键同请求并发或重启后重放首次状态码与响应字节，不重复过账；批次与单笔结算或其他批次并发争用同一评估时只能一方提交，败者得到 `409`/`settlement_exists`，成功项不得重号或造成透支。
- `GET /v1/settlement-batches/{id}`：读取一个结算批次。携带任意查询参数返回 `400`/`invalid_request`（先于批次查询）；批次标识非法或不存在返回 `404`/`not_found`。成功返回 `200` 与首次创建时的完整对象（键序与字段逐字沿 POST，含统一 `createdAt` 与有序结算结果）。批次内各结算仍出现在现有 SLA 结算分页（`GET /v1/slas/{id}/settlements`）与账户账本（`GET /v1/accounts/{id}/ledger`）中，账本 `settlement` 分录的 `referenceSeq` 为对应结算序号，且可由现有争议入口（`POST /v1/disputes`）按 `settlementSeq` 使用；其他公开接口、认证约定、金额单位、分页快照和存储生命周期保持不变。
- `GET /v1/settlement-batches`：分页浏览结算批次集合，与按 id 读取一样不要求 `SLA-Auth`。查询参数仅允许且每项限单值 `slaId`、`limit`、`cursor`；`slaId` 沿用现有标识格式 `[a-z0-9-]{1,64}`，提供时只返回至少含该 SLA 一笔结算的批次；`limit` 为无前导零十进制整数、范围 `1..100`，缺省 `50`；`cursor=cut:lastSeq`，两段均为无前导零十进制整数。缺值、未知/重复参数、格式或范围非法、`lastSeq` 大于 `cut` 均在 SLA 查询之前返回 `400`/`invalid_request`；`slaId` 格式合法但不存在返回 `404`/`not_found`。无 `cursor` 时，`cut` 取同一读事务起点的全库最大 `settlementSeq`（空库为 `0`）；批次按其最小 `settlementSeq` 升序，返回最小序号大于 `lastSeq`（首页为 `0`）且不大于 `cut` 的匹配批次。`cut` 大于当前全库最大结算序号、或 `lastSeq` 不是当前筛选下不超过 `cut` 的真实批次锚点（即某匹配批次的最小结算序号），均为 `400`/`invalid_request`（这些状态校验在 SLA 查询之后）。成功为 `200`，正文键序 `batches,nextCursor`；`batches` 为完整批次对象数组，每项与 `GET /v1/settlement-batches/{id}` 的完整对象逐字段一致（含全部有序 `settlements`），单笔结算不出现。页长不超过 `limit`；有后页时 `nextCursor` 为 `cut:末项最小序号`，否则为 `null`；空结果返回 `{"batches":[],"nextCursor":null}`。`cut` 由游标携带并跨并发写入与重启稳定；快照建立后新增的批次或单笔结算不进入旧快照，续页不重复、不遗漏（全新首页才取新 `cut`）；升级前批次按原序号直接参与排序、筛选和分页，其已保存的首次响应字节不变。
- `GET /v1/slas/{id}/settlements`：分页读取 SLA 资金结算。查询参数仅允许且每项限单值 `limit`、`cursor`；`limit` 为无前导零十进制整数、范围 `1..100`，缺省 `50`；`cursor=cut:lastSeq`，两段均为无前导零十进制整数。缺项、未知/重复参数、格式或范围非法均在 SLA 查询之前返回 `400`/`invalid_request`。无 `cursor` 时，`cut` 取同一读事务起点的全库最大 `settlementSeq`（空库为 `0`）；按全局序号升序返回该 SLA 内 `0<settlementSeq<=cut` 的结算，续页在同一 `cut` 下再限 `settlementSeq>lastSeq`。`cut` 大于当前全库最大序号、或 `lastSeq` 锚点在该 SLA 内且不大于 `cut` 却不存在，均为 `400`/`invalid_request`（这些状态校验在 SLA 查询之后）；SLA 不存在（含非法 id）为 `404`/`not_found`。成功为 `200`，正文键序 `settlements,nextCursor`；`settlements` 为对象数组，元素键序 `settlementSeq,evaluationSeq,result,amount,payerId,payeeId,createdAt`，前四字段与时间沿用 POST 结算响应取值，`payerId`、`payeeId` 在 `pending` 时为 `null`，其余为机器 id。页长不超过 `limit`；有后页时 `nextCursor` 为 `cut:末序号`，否则为 `null`。`cut` 由游标携带并跨重启稳定；读取期间的并发新增不影响续页（全新首页才取新 `cut`）；旧库结算按原序号直接参与分页。
- `GET /v1/accounts/{id}/ledger`：分页读取账户账本分录。账户仅接受已登记机器 id 或 `external:clearing`；合法账户无分录时返回空页，其他账户返回 `404`/`not_found`。查询参数、`limit`、`cursor=cut:lastSeq` 的格式与范围、缺项/未知/重复参数处理及错误次序均沿用 SLA 评估查询（参数错误先于账户查询返回 `400`/`invalid_request`）。无 `cursor` 时，`cut` 取同一读事务起点的全库最大 `entrySeq`（空库为 `0`）；按全局 `entrySeq` 升序返回目标账户内 `0<entrySeq<=cut` 的分录，续页在同一 `cut` 下再限 `entrySeq>lastSeq`。`cut` 大于当前全库最大序号、或 `lastSeq` 锚点在目标账户内且不大于 `cut` 却不存在，均为 `400`/`invalid_request`（这些状态校验在账户查询之后）。成功为 `200`，正文键序 `entries,nextCursor`；`entries` 为对象数组，元素键序固定为 `entrySeq,kind,referenceSeq,reference,slaId,evaluationSeq,delta,balanceAfter,createdAt`。`deposit` 分录 `reference` 为入金原始引用、`slaId` 与 `evaluationSeq` 为 `null`；`withdrawal` 分录 `reference` 为出金请求 `id`、`referenceSeq` 为出金序号，`slaId` 与 `evaluationSeq` 为 `null`；`settlement` 分录反之，`reference` 为 `null`，`slaId`、`evaluationSeq` 关联对应结算的 SLA 与评估；`dispute_refund` 分录 `reference` 为 `null`，`referenceSeq` 为被退款结算的结算序号，`slaId`、`evaluationSeq` 关联该结算；`dispute_escalation` 分录 `reference` 为 `null`，`referenceSeq` 为升级序号，`slaId`、`evaluationSeq` 关联被升级争议的结算；`dispute_arbitration` 分录 `reference` 为 `null`，`referenceSeq` 为仲裁序号，`slaId`、`evaluationSeq` 关联被仲裁争议的结算。`delta`、`balanceAfter` 为有符号整数，`createdAt` 为非负整数。页长不超过 `limit`；有后页时 `nextCursor` 为 `cut:末序号`，否则为 `null`。`cut` 由游标携带并跨重启稳定，读取期间的并发新增不影响续页（全新首页才取新 `cut`）；旧库分录按原 `entrySeq` 直接参与分页。
- `POST /v1/disputes`：对一笔正金额结算创建争议并冻结收款方等额资金。请求须携带 `Idempotency-Key` 头（格式同上），JSON 请求体仅含且不得重复 `id`（`[a-z0-9-]{1,64}`）、`settlementSeq`（非布尔正整数）、`claimantId`（`[0-9a-f]{64}`）。判定顺序为头、体、幂等记录、结算、身份、状态、唯一性：头或体非法返回 `400`/`invalid_request`；同键异请求返回 `409`/`conflict`；结算不存在返回 `404`/`not_found`；`claimantId` 非原付款方返回 `403`/`forbidden`；结算为 `pending`、零金额或其他不可争议状态返回 `409`/`conflict`；异键重复 `id` 或重复结算序号返回 `409`/`dispute_exists`。仅 `charged` 或 `compensated` 且金额为正的结算可被其原付款方争议。首次成功在同一写事务内原子冻结收款方等额资金（冻结仅登记 open 争议、不写账本）并记录一条 `opened` 生命周期事件，返回 `201`，正文键序 `id,open,amount`，`open` 为 `true`，`amount` 为结算金额。账户可用余额为总余额扣除全部 open 争议冻结额后与零的较大值（旧库冻结超额时按零判断）；入金先补缺口，结算扣款仅可使用可用余额。同键同请求并发或重启后重放首次状态码与响应字节；争议、生命周期事件与幂等结果原子持久化，失败无任何副作用也不写事件；并发创建同一争议至多成功一次。

def test_sequences_are_global_across_accounts(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.post_withdrawal()[0], 201)
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(
            self.withdrawal_body("wd-2", 10),
            account=self.other_id,
            idempotency_key="wd-key-2",
        )
        # 其他机器无余额：可用余额不足。
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "insufficient_funds"})
        request = Request(
            self.url(f"/v1/funds/{self.other_id}"),
            data=json.dumps({"amountMicros": 50, "reference": "ref-2"}).encode(),
            method="POST",
        )
        request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", "fund-2")
        with urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
            self.assertEqual(response.status, 201)
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(
            self.withdrawal_body("wd-2", 10),
            account=self.other_id,
            idempotency_key="wd-key-2",
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body)["withdrawalSeq"], 2)

    def test_insufficient_funds(self) -> None:
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(self.withdrawal_body("wd-1", 1001))
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "insufficient_funds"})
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(
            self.withdrawal_body("wd-1", 1000), idempotency_key="wd-key-2"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body)["balance"], 0)

    def test_frozen_funds_not_withdrawable(self) -> None:
        self.freeze(300)
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(self.withdrawal_body("wd-1", 701))
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "insufficient_funds"})
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(
            self.withdrawal_body("wd-1", 700), idempotency_key="wd-key-2"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        payload = json.loads(body)
        self.assertEqual(payload["balance"], 300)
        self.assertEqual(payload["availableBalance"], 0)

    def test_unknown_account_is_404(self) -> None:
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(account="ab" * 32)
        self.assertEqual(status, 404)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "not_found"})

    def test_auth_machine_mismatch_is_403(self) -> None:
        body = self.withdrawal_body()
        auth = make_sla_auth(
            self.server,
            "wd-key-1",
            PUBLIC_KEY_SEED_B,
            self.other_id,
            "POST",
            f"/v1/accounts/{self.machine_id}/withdrawals",
            body,
            1,
        )
        status, payload = self.post_withdrawal(body, auth=auth)
        self.assertEqual(status, 403)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(payload), {"error": "forbidden"})

    def test_missing_or_invalid_headers(self) -> None:
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(idempotency_key=None)
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "invalid_request"})
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(idempotency_key="bad key!")
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "invalid_request"})
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(query="x=1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "invalid_request"})
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(omit_auth=True)
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "invalid_request"})
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(auth="not-an-auth-header")
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "invalid_request"})
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(
            extra_headers={"SLA-Delegation": "d;0;1;n;" + "0" * 128}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "invalid_request"})

    def test_invalid_bodies(self) -> None:
        bodies = [
            b"{}",
            b'{"id":"wd-1"}',
            b'{"amountMicros":400}',
            b'{"id":"wd-1","amountMicros":400,"extra":1}',
            b'{"id":"WD-1","amountMicros":400}',
            b'{"id":"","amountMicros":400}',
            b'{"id":1,"amountMicros":400}',
            b'{"id":"wd-1","amountMicros":0}',
            b'{"id":"wd-1","amountMicros":-5}',
            b'{"id":"wd-1","amountMicros":9000000000000001}',
            b'{"id":"wd-1","amountMicros":true}',
            b'{"id":"wd-1","amountMicros":"400"}',
            b'{"id":"wd-1","id":"wd-1","amountMicros":400}',
            b"not-json",
        ]
        for index, body in enumerate(bodies):
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                status, payload = self.post_withdrawal(
                    body, idempotency_key=f"bad-{index}"
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertEqual(json.loads(payload), {"error": "invalid_request"})

    def test_boundary_amount_accepted(self) -> None:
        request = Request(
            self.url(f"/v1/funds/{self.machine_id}"),
            data=json.dumps(
                {"amountMicros": 9000000000000000 - 1000, "reference": "ref-2"}
            ).encode(),
            method="POST",
        )
        request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", "fund-2")
        with urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
            self.assertEqual(response.status, 201)
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(
            self.withdrawal_body("wd-1", 9000000000000000)
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body)["balance"], 0)

    def test_replay_returns_first_response_bytes(self) -> None:
        _, first = self.post_withdrawal()
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal()
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(body, first)

    def test_replay_survives_restart(self) -> None:
        _, first = self.post_withdrawal()
        self.restart()
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal()
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(body, first)

    def test_same_key_different_request_conflicts(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.post_withdrawal()[0], 201)
        # 同键异体。

        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(body_bytes, auth=auth)

    def test_duplicate_id_different_key(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.post_withdrawal()[0], 201)
        status, body = self.post_withdrawal(
            self.withdrawal_body("wd-1", 100), idempotency_key="wd-key-2"
        )

def test_concurrent_same_id_different_keys_single_success(self) -> None:
        results: list[tuple[int, bytes]] = []
        lock = threading.Lock()

        def withdraw(index: int) -> None:
            outcome = self.post_withdrawal(
                self.withdrawal_body("wd-1", 100),
                idempotency_key=f"wd-key-{index}",
            )
            with lock:
                results.append(outcome)

        threads = [
            threading.Thread(target=withdraw, args=(index,)) for index in range(8)
        ]
        for thread in threads:
            thread.start()
        for thread in threads:
            thread.join()
        successes = [body for status, body in results if status == 201]
        self.assertEqual(len(successes), 1)
        for status, body in results:
            if status != 201:
                self.assertEqual(status, 409)
                self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "withdrawal_exists"})

    def test_concurrent_withdrawals_never_overdraw(self) -> None:
        results: list[tuple[int, bytes]] = []
        lock = threading.Lock()

        def withdraw(index: int) -> None:
            outcome = self.post_withdrawal(
                self.withdrawal_body(f"wd-{index}", 200),
                idempotency_key=f"wd-key-{index}",
            )
            with lock:
                results.append(outcome)

        threads = [
            threading.Thread(target=withdraw, args=(index,)) for index in range(8)
        ]
        for thread in threads:
            thread.start()
        for thread in threads:
            thread.join()
        successes = [result for result in results if result[0] == 201]
        failures = [result for result in results if result[0] != 201]
        self.assertEqual(len(successes), 5)
        self.assertEqual(len(failures), 3)
        for status, body in failures:
            self.assertEqual(status, 409)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "insufficient_funds"})
        sequences = sorted(json.loads(body)["withdrawalSeq"] for _, body in successes)
        self.assertEqual(sequences, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
        entries = self.ledger(self.machine_id)
        self.assertEqual(entries[-1]["balanceAfter"], 0)

class WithdrawalBatchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.server = ApiServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        self.server.database_path = str(Path(self.temporary.name) / "service.db")
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()
        self.machine_id = machine_id(PUBLIC_KEY_A)
        self.other_id = machine_id(PUBLIC_KEY_B)
        for key, public_key in (("register-1", PUBLIC_KEY_A), ("register-2", PUBLIC_KEY_B)):
            request = Request(
                self.url("/v1/machines"),
                data=json.dumps({"publicKey": public_key}).encode(),
                method="POST",
            )
            request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", key)
            with urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
                self.assertEqual(response.status, 201)
        # 机器账户入金 1000，供批量出金场景使用。
        request = Request(
            self.url(f"/v1/funds/{self.machine_id}"),
            data=json.dumps({"amountMicros": 1000, "reference": "ref-1"}).encode(),
            method="POST",
        )
        request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", "fund-1")
        with urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
            self.assertEqual(response.status, 201)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()
        self.thread.join(timeout=2)
        self.temporary.cleanup()

    def url(self, path: str) -> str:
        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_port}{path}"

    def restart(self) -> None:
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()
        self.thread.join(timeout=2)
        self.server = ApiServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        self.server.database_path = str(Path(self.temporary.name) / "service.db")
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()

    def batch_body(
        self,
        batch_id: object = "wdb-1",
        items: object = (( "wi-1", 400), ("wi-2", 300)),
    ) -> bytes:
        return json.dumps(
            {
                "id": batch_id,
                "items": [
                    {"id": item_id, "amountMicros": amount}
                    for item_id, amount in items
                ],
            }
        ).encode()

    def post_batch(
        self,
        body: bytes | None = None,
        account: str | None = None,
        idempotency_key: str | None = "wdb-key-1",
        query: str = "",
        auth: str | None = None,
        omit_auth: bool = False,
        extra_headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[int, bytes]:
        if body is None:
            body = self.batch_body()
        if account is None:
            account = self.machine_id
        suffix = f"?{query}" if query else ""
        path = f"/v1/accounts/{account}/withdrawal-batches"
        request = Request(self.url(f"{path}{suffix}"), data=body, method="POST")
        if idempotency_key is not None:
            request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", idempotency_key)
        if not omit_auth:
            if auth is None:
                add_sla_auth(request, self.server)
            else:
                request.add_header("SLA-Auth", auth)
        for name, value in (extra_headers or {}).items():
            request.add_header(name, value)
        try:
            with urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
                return response.status, response.read()
        except HTTPError as error:
            return error.code, error.read()

    def post_single_withdrawal(
        self, withdrawal_id: str, amount: int, idempotency_key: str
    ) -> tuple[int, bytes]:
        body = json.dumps({"id": withdrawal_id, "amountMicros": amount}).encode()
        path = f"/v1/accounts/{self.machine_id}/withdrawals"
        request = Request(self.url(path), data=body, method="POST")
        request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", idempotency_key)
        add_sla_auth(request, self.server)
        try:
            with urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
                return response.status, response.read()
        except HTTPError as error:
            return error.code, error.read()

    def ledger(self, account: str) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
        request = Request(self.url(f"/v1/accounts/{account}/ledger"), method="GET")
        with urlopen(request, timeout=5) as response:
            self.assertEqual(response.status, 200)
            return json.loads(response.read())["entries"]

    def freeze(self, amount: int) -> None:
        # 直接登记一笔 open 争议：收款方为出金机器，冻结其等额资金。
        connection = sqlite3.connect(self.server.database_path)
        try:
            connection.execute(
                "INSERT INTO disputes"
                "(id, settlement_seq, claimant_id, payer_id, payee_id,"
                " amount_micros, state)"
                " VALUES ('dp-1', 999, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'open')",
                (self.other_id, self.other_id, self.machine_id, amount),
            )
            connection.commit()
        finally:
            connection.close()

    def test_batch_created_response(self) -> None:
        status, body = self.post_batch()
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        payload = json.loads(body)
        self.assertEqual(list(payload), ["id", "createdAt", "withdrawals"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["id"], "wdb-1")
        self.assertIsInstance(payload["createdAt"], int)
        withdrawals = payload["withdrawals"]
        self.assertEqual(len(withdrawals), 2)
        for item in withdrawals:
            self.assertEqual(
                list(item),
                ["id", "withdrawalSeq", "amountMicros", "balance",
                 "availableBalance", "createdAt"],
            )
            self.assertEqual(item["createdAt"], payload["createdAt"])
        self.assertEqual(
            [(item["id"], item["withdrawalSeq"], item["amountMicros"]) for item in withdrawals],
            [("wi-1", 1, 400), ("wi-2", 2, 300)],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            [item["balance"] for item in withdrawals], [600, 300]
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            [item["availableBalance"] for item in withdrawals], [600, 300]
        )

    def test_batch_writes_paired_entries_and_records(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.post_batch()[0], 201)
        connection = sqlite3.connect(self.server.database_path)
        connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        try:
            entries = connection.execute(
                "SELECT kind, reference_seq, account_id, delta_micros,"
                " balance_after_micros FROM ledger_entries"
                " WHERE kind = 'withdrawal' ORDER BY entry_seq ASC"
            ).fetchall()
            self.assertEqual(
                [
                    (
                        row["kind"],
                        row["reference_seq"],
                        row["account_id"],
                        row["delta_micros"],
                        row["balance_after_micros"],
                    )
                    for row in entries
                ],
                [
                    ("withdrawal", 1, self.machine_id, -400, 600),
                    ("withdrawal", 1, "external:clearing", 400, -600),
                    ("withdrawal", 2, self.machine_id, -300, 300),
                    ("withdrawal", 2, "external:clearing", 300, -300),
                ],
            )
            rows = connection.execute(
                "SELECT withdrawal_seq, id, machine_id, amount_micros"
                " FROM withdrawals ORDER BY withdrawal_seq ASC"
            ).fetchall()
            self.assertEqual(
                [
                    (row["withdrawal_seq"], row["id"], row["amount_micros"])
                    for row in rows
                ],
                [(1, "wi-1", 400), (2, "wi-2", 300)],
            )
            batch = connection.execute(
                "SELECT id FROM withdrawal_batches"
            ).fetchone()
            self.assertEqual(batch["id"], "wdb-1")
        finally:
            connection.close()
        # 账本分页沿用既有语义：reference 为项目 id，referenceSeq 为出金序号。
        machine_entries = [
            entry for entry in self.ledger(self.machine_id)
            if entry["kind"] == "withdrawal"
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            [
                (entry["referenceSeq"], entry["reference"], entry["delta"])
                for entry in machine_entries
            ],
            [(1, "wi-1", -400), (2, "wi-2", -300)],
        )

    def test_sequential_balance_check_within_batch(self) -> None:
        # 单项均可负担，但累计超出可用余额：第二项失败，整批无写入。
        status, body = self.post_batch(
            self.batch_body("wdb-1", (("wi-1", 700), ("wi-2", 400)))
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "insufficient_funds"})
        connection = sqlite3.connect(self.server.database_path)
        try:
            self.assertEqual(
                connection.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM withdrawals").fetchone()[0],
                0,
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                connection.execute(
                    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM withdrawal_batches"
                ).fetchone()[0],
                0,
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                connection.execute(
                    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM withdrawal_batch_idempotency_records"
                ).fetchone()[0],
                0,
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                connection.execute(
                    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_nonce_records"
                ).fetchone()[0],
                0,
            )
        finally:
            connection.close()
        # 补正后原键可重试，序号从 1 开始连续分配。
        status, body = self.post_batch(
            self.batch_body("wdb-1", (("wi-1", 700), ("wi-2", 300)))
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        payload = json.loads(body)
        self.assertEqual(
            [item["withdrawalSeq"] for item in payload["withdrawals"]], [1, 2]
        )

    def test_frozen_funds_not_withdrawable_in_batch(self) -> None:
        self.freeze(300)
        status, body = self.post_batch(
            self.batch_body("wdb-1", (("wi-1", 400), ("wi-2", 301)))
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "insufficient_funds"})
        status, body = self.post_batch(
            self.batch_body("wdb-1", (("wi-1", 400), ("wi-2", 300))),
            idempotency_key="wdb-key-2",
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        payload = json.loads(body)
        self.assertEqual(payload["withdrawals"][-1]["balance"], 300)
        self.assertEqual(payload["withdrawals"][-1]["availableBalance"], 0)

    def test_batch_id_conflict_different_key(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.post_batch()[0], 201)
        status, body = self.post_batch(
            self.batch_body("wdb-1", (("wi-9", 100),)),
            idempotency_key="wdb-key-2",
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "batch_exists"})

    def test_item_id_conflicts_with_single_withdrawal(self) -> None:
        status, _ = self.post_single_withdrawal("wi-1", 100, "wd-key-1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        status, body = self.post_batch()
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "withdrawal_exists"})

    def test_single_withdrawal_conflicts_with_batch_item_id(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.post_batch()[0], 201)
        status, body = self.post_single_withdrawal("wi-2", 100, "wd-key-2")
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "withdrawal_exists"})

    def test_sequences_shared_with_single_withdrawal(self) -> None:
        status, body = self.post_batch()
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(
            [item["withdrawalSeq"] for item in json.loads(body)["withdrawals"]],
            [1, 2],
        )
        status, body = self.post_single_withdrawal("wd-9", 100, "wd-key-9")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body)["withdrawalSeq"], 3)
        status, body = self.post_batch(
            self.batch_body("wdb-2", (("wi-3", 100),)), idempotency_key="wdb-key-2"
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(
            json.loads(body)["withdrawals"][0]["withdrawalSeq"], 4
        )

    def test_missing_or_invalid_headers(self) -> None:
        status, body = self.post_batch(idempotency_key=None)
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "invalid_request"})
        status, body = self.post_batch(idempotency_key="bad key!")
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "invalid_request"})
        status, body = self.post_batch(query="x=1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "invalid_request"})
        status, body = self.post_batch(omit_auth=True)
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "invalid_request"})
        status, body = self.post_batch(auth="not-an-auth-header")
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "invalid_request"})
        status, body = self.post_batch(
            extra_headers={"SLA-Delegation": "d;0;1;n;" + "0" * 128}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(body), {"error": "invalid_request"})

    def test_invalid_bodies(self) -> None:
        too_many = json.dumps(
            {
                "id": "wdb-1",
                "items": [
                    {"id": f"wi-{index}", "amountMicros": 1}
                    for index in range(101)
                ],
            }
        ).encode()

            b"{}",
            b'{"id":"wdb-1"}',
            b'{"items":[{"id":"wi-1","amountMicros":1}]}',

            b'{"id":1,"items":[{"id":"wi-1","amountMicros":1}]}',
            b'{"id":"wdb-1","items":{}}',

        self.assertEqual(status, 404)

    def post_batch(
        self,

        idempotency_key: str | None = "wdb-key-1",
        query: str = "",
        auth: str | None = None,
        omit_auth: bool = False,
        extra_headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[int, bytes]:
        if body is None:
            body = self.batch_body()
        if account is None:
            account = self.machine_id
        suffix = f"?{query}" if query else ""
        path = f"/v1/accounts/{account}/withdrawal-batches"
        request = Request(self.url(f"{path}{suffix}"), data=body, method="POST")
        if idempotency_key is not None:
            request.add_header("Idempotency-Key", idempotency_key)
        if not omit_auth:
            if auth is None:
                add_sla_auth(request, self.server)
            else:
                request.add_header("SLA-Auth", auth)
        for name, value in (extra_headers or {}).items():
            request.add_header(name, value)
        try:

                return response.status, response.read()

        ]
        for thread in threads:
            thread.start()
        for thread in threads:

content.text:
完成。全套 1416 个测试通过（含新增 20 个批量出金测试）。

## 改动摘要

**`sla_network/database.py`** — 新增两张表（`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`，旧库连接时自动补齐，无需迁移）：
- `withdrawal_batches(id, created_at_ms, response_json)`
- `withdrawal_batch_idempotency_records(key, machine_id, request_json, status, response_json, auth 五段)`，与单笔出金幂等记录同构

**`sla_network/server.py`** — 新增 `POST /v1/accounts/{id}/withdrawal-batches`（`server.py:5345` 起）：
- 入口 `_create_withdrawal_batch`：依次校验 Idempotency-Key、查询参数、正文、SLA-Delegation、SLA-Auth 结构，顺序与单笔出金一致
- `_read_withdrawal_batch_object`：正文仅含 `id`+`items`，items 1–100 项，每项仅含批内唯一 `id`（`[a-z0-9-]{1,64}`）与 `amountMicros`（1–9e15），结构非法一律 400
- `_apply_withdrawal_batch`：单写事务（`BEGIN IMMEDIATE`）内按 幂等记录 → 账户（404) → 身份（403) → 认证（401 stale/invalid、409 replay) → 批次唯一性（409 batch_exists) → 项目唯一性（409 withdrawal_exists，与单笔共用 `withdrawals` 命名空间） → 逐项余额（409 insufficient_funds）判定；前项扣款参与后项可用余额（总余额 − open 争议冻结，与零取大）校验
- 全部通过后按数组顺序分配与单笔共享、连续、全库唯一的 `withdrawalSeq`，全批共用一个 UTC 毫秒 `createdAt`；每项借记机器账户、贷记 `external:clearing` 并写成对 `withdrawal` 分录（`reference`=项目 id、`referenceSeq`=withdrawalSeq）；批次、出金、分录、余额、随机数、幂等结果同事务提交，任一失败整批回滚、不消耗随机数与序号，补正后原键可重试
- 201 正文键序 `id,createdAt,withdrawals`，每项沿用单笔响应键序 `id,withdrawalSeq,amountMicros,balance,availableBalance,createdAt`；同键同请求（含并发、重启后）逐字节重放首次响应，同键换路径/正文/认证五段返回 409/conflict

**`README.md`** — 在单笔出金条目后新增第 45 条端点规范。

**`tests/test_server.py`** — `_sla_auth_actor` 识别新路径；新增 `WithdrawalBatchTests`（20 个用例）：响应键序与统一 createdAt、成对分录与账本 `reference`/`referenceSeq`、批内顺序余额校验、冻结资金、batch_exists、与单笔双向 withdrawal_exists、序号共享连续、400/401/403/404/409 各错误、同键冲突、重放（含重启）、同键并发唯一成功、异键并发不透支且序号连续。

现有单笔出金、账本分页、结算、争议冻结与审计语义均未改动（审计逻辑直接复用 `withdrawals` 表，批内出金自动纳入核对）。
